name: git-repository
artifact_model: host -> repository -> branch -> commit -> tree -> blob
traversal_protocol: Enumerate repositories then refs and recursively walk Git trees via Git smart HTTP or host APIs
notes: Use commit snapshots to make traversal reproducible.

name: package-release
artifact_model: registry -> package -> version -> distribution file -> source file
traversal_protocol: Enumerate package names and releases through registry APIs then fetch source distributions
notes: Prefer source archives over built artifacts when both exist.

name: notebook
artifact_model: service -> user or organization -> notebook -> revision -> cell
traversal_protocol: Enumerate public notebooks through gallery or search APIs and read code cells from exported notebook documents
notes: Record notebook revision or retrieval time.

name: online-project
traversal_protocol: Enumerate public projects through service APIs or search and fetch project files
notes: Some services expose only rendered source and require page parsing.

name: web-page-code-blocks
traversal_protocol: Discover pages from sitemaps feeds APIs or crawl frontiers then extract code blocks with page provenance
notes: Store page canonical URL and retrieval timestamp.

name: forum-post-code
traversal_protocol: Enumerate topics and posts through APIs dumps or HTML then extract code blocks
notes: Preserve post identity and edit timestamp where available.

name: code-snippet
traversal_protocol: Enumerate public snippets through user indexes chronological feeds or APIs and fetch every file and revision
notes: Preserve attribution creation time and revision identity.

name: research-deposit
traversal_protocol: Enumerate deposit metadata APIs and fetch files for records marked as software or code
notes: Preserve DOI resource type and deposit version.

name: archived-origin
artifact_model: archive -> origin -> visit -> snapshot -> directory -> content
traversal_protocol: Enumerate origins and visits then walk the selected archive snapshot through content-addressed APIs
notes: Record original provenance URL and archive visit timestamp.

name: model-repository
traversal_protocol: Enumerate public repositories and revisions with hub APIs then walk repository files
notes: Classify model weights separately from source notebooks and application code.

name: extension-package
artifact_model: marketplace -> publisher -> extension -> version -> package -> file
traversal_protocol: Enumerate public extensions and versions then fetch distributable archives and extract source files
notes: Prefer source maps and unminified files when present.
